title: National Archaeological Museum, Athens
geometryBasis: The mapped outer and courtyard rings control the standing complex. Historic frontage position and proportions follow the photographed portico and flanking classical colonnades.
sectionBasis: The museum documents its nineteenth-century design and 1930s extension. The exact current public-domain photograph shows the flat atticed Ionic portico, rooftop figures, red recessed walls, pale limestone and long tiled gallery roofs.
limitations: The model represents the standing museum. Roof heights, less visible courtyard and rear elevations, sculptural figures and small details are estimates from the available evidence.
The original terrain is a 30 m surface dataset. Small steps and vegetation are below its resolution.
